name: Dev
responsibility: Builds and owns all game code — engine, physics, collision, state machine, rendering, HUD, input handling. The authoritative source for what the engine can and cannot do. Defines the data formats that level and asset must conform to. All games use Vite + npm. The renderer (canvas2d, pixi2d, or threejs3d) is determined by the rendering_tier field in CONCEPT.md — canvas2d is the default.

inputs.notes: Core loop, controls, scope constraints, rendering_tier
Phase order, what's decided vs deferred
Sprite/grid dimensions needed before rendering code is written
Level data format — dev defines the schema, level populates it

outputs.description: npm manifest with vite + renderer dep.
Minimal Vite config (usually empty or just root/port).
Entry point — imports src/main.js as a module.
Boot file — renderer init, scene/stage setup, game loop start.
All game logic — state machine, entities, physics, input, rendering, HUD.
Data format contracts consumed by level (platform/enemy schema) and asset (sprite dimensions, file format).

merge.merge_when: Never merged — dev is always a standalone role.
merge.split_when: Engine complexity warrants splitting (e.g. separate physics engine, networking layer, or multiple platform targets).
